title: View public home
steps: Open /; inspect page title and navigation
expected: Home renders with links to explore and sign in

title: Successful login
steps: Open /user/login; enter fixture username and password; submit
expected: Authenticated dashboard is shown

title: Reject wrong password
steps: Open login; enter qaowner and wrong-password; submit
expected: Error is shown and no authenticated session is established

title: Reject unknown user
steps: Open login; enter nonexistent-user and arbitrary password; submit
expected: Login is refused without an authenticated session

title: Required login fields
steps: Open login; leave username and password blank; submit
expected: Validation prevents login and required fields are identified

title: Logout revokes UI session
steps: Open account menu; sign out; revisit dashboard
expected: Authenticated dashboard is unavailable until signing in again

title: Public repository visible
steps: Open /qaowner/journeys; inspect name and README
expected: Repository name and initialized content are visible

title: Private repository hidden
steps: Open /qaowner/private-fixture directly
expected: Not-found response hides private repository contents

title: Owner opens private repository
steps: Open /qaowner/private-fixture
expected: Owner can view private repository contents

title: Create public repository
steps: Create repository with unique name manual-public and public visibility; open it
expected: Repository is saved under qaowner with public visibility

title: Create private repository
steps: Create unique manual-private repository with private visibility; inspect as anonymous
expected: Owner sees repository and anonymous visitor cannot see contents

title: Reject duplicate repository
preconditions: journeys fixture exists and owner logged in
steps: Create another repository named journeys
expected: Useful validation rejects duplicate and existing repository remains intact

title: Reject empty repository name
steps: Open new repository form; leave name empty; submit
expected: Required-name validation prevents creation

title: Reject path-like repository name
steps: Enter ../escape as repository name; submit
expected: Validation rejects name and creates no repository

title: Edit repository description
steps: Open repository settings; change description to Manual QA update; save; reload
expected: New description persists after reload

title: Delete disposable repository
steps: Delete through settings with required confirmation; reopen repository URL
expected: Repository is deleted and URL returns not found

title: View issue list
steps: Open /qaowner/journeys/issues; open Seed issue
expected: Issue list and detail show saved seed issue

title: Create issue
preconditions: Owner logged in and journeys exists
steps: Open new issue; enter unique title and body; submit; reload
expected: Issue receives a number and title/body persist

title: Reject empty issue title
steps: Open new issue; leave title blank; enter body; submit
expected: Validation blocks issue creation

title: Edit issue content
preconditions: Owner logged in and disposable issue exists
steps: Edit issue title and body; save; reload
expected: Edited content persists with correct issue identity

title: Close issue
preconditions: Owner logged in and open disposable issue exists
steps: Open issue; select Close Issue; reload
expected: Closed state persists and issue moves out of open list

title: Reopen issue
preconditions: Owner logged in and closed disposable issue exists
steps: Open closed issue; select Reopen Issue; reload
expected: Open state persists and issue appears in open list

title: Markdown and Unicode issue body
preconditions: Owner logged in and disposable issue exists
steps: Save body containing café 日本語 and Markdown heading; view rendered body
expected: Unicode persists and heading renders without corrupting content

title: Anonymous issue write boundary
steps: Open new-issue URL; attempt to reach submission flow
expected: Authentication is required before creating an issue

title: Explore repository search
steps: Open /explore/repos; search journeys; search private-fixture
expected: Public fixture is searchable and private fixture is not exposed

title: Keyboard login
steps: Tab through login; enter fixture values; submit with keyboard
expected: Focus is visible and login is operable without pointer

title: Zoom and narrow layout
steps: Set zoom 200 percent; inspect login and repository issue list; test narrow viewport
expected: Core content and controls remain reachable without overlap hiding actions

title: API authentication errors
preconditions: REST client with no stored credentials
steps: GET /api/v1/user without auth; repeat with invalid token
expected: Both requests return 401 and no user profile

title: API malformed JSON
preconditions: REST client with fixture basic auth
steps: POST /api/v1/user/repos with Content-Type application/json and body {
expected: 400 response rejects malformed JSON without creating a repository

title: API Swagger response contract
steps: Download /swagger.v1.json; GET version and repository and issue endpoints; validate documented responses
expected: Responses conform to served Swagger status and schemas
